pages.caption: all of them were not in love they were ready to die for hunger.

pages.caption: and told the Princess aloud that supper was served up.

pages.description: [establishing shot of princess dressed magnificently]

pages.caption: his royal highness took care not to tell her that she was dressed like his
pages.description: [close-up detail of princess dressed magnificently]

pages.caption: great-grandmother,
pages.description: [characters in princess dressed magnificently]

pages.caption: and had a point band peeping over a high collar; she looked not a bit
pages.description: [wide view of princess dressed magnificently]

pages.caption: less charming and beautiful for all that.

pages.description: [establishing shot of supper in the hall of looking-glasses]

pages.scene: Supper in the hall of looking-glasses

pages.caption: was now above a hundred years since they had played;
pages.description: [characters in supper in the hall of looking-glasses]
pages.scene: Supper in the hall of looking-glasses

pages.caption: and after supper, without losing any time, the lord almoner married them in the chapel
pages.description: [establishing shot of wedding in the chapel]

pages.caption: of the castle, and the chief lady of honor drew the curtains. They had but
pages.description: [close-up detail of wedding in the chapel]

pages.caption: very little sleep--the Princess had no occasion;
pages.description: [characters in wedding in the chapel]

pages.description: [establishing shot of prince departing next morning]

pages.caption: needs have been in pain for him. The Prince told him:
pages.description: [close-up detail of prince departing next morning]

pages.caption: That he lost his way in the forest as he was hunting, and that he

pages.caption: had lain in the cottage of a charcoal-burner, who gave him cheese and brown bread.
pages.description: [close-up detail of prince lying to the king]

pages.description: [establishing shot of king believing, queen mother suspicious]

pages.caption: not be persuaded it was true;
pages.description: [close-up detail of king believing, queen mother suspicious]

pages.caption: and seeing that he went almost every day a-hunting, and that he always had some

pages.caption: excuse ready for so doing, though he had lain out three or four nights together,
pages.description: [close-up detail of prince visiting princess secretly]

pages.caption: she began to suspect that he was married, for he lived with the Princess above

pages.description: [wide view of prince visiting princess secretly]

pages.caption: a daughter,
pages.description: [intimate moment in prince visiting princess secretly]

pages.caption: did pass his time, and that in this he ought in duty to satisfy her.

pages.caption: loved her,
pages.description: [close-up detail of prince afraid of his ogress mother]
pages.scene: Prince afraid of his ogress mother

pages.caption: for she was of the race of the Ogres, and the King would never have
pages.description: [characters in prince afraid of his ogress mother]
pages.scene: Prince afraid of his ogress mother

pages.caption: married her had it not been for her vast riches; it was even whispered about
pages.description: [wide view of prince afraid of his ogress mother]
pages.scene: Prince afraid of his ogress mother

pages.caption: the Court that she had Ogreish inclinations, and that, whenever she saw little children passing
pages.description: [intimate moment in prince afraid of his ogress mother]
pages.scene: Prince afraid of his ogress mother

pages.caption: by,
pages.description: [dramatic angle of prince afraid of his ogress mother]
pages.scene: Prince afraid of his ogress mother

pages.caption: the Prince would never tell her one word.
pages.description: [atmospheric shot of prince afraid of his ogress mother]
pages.scene: Prince afraid of his ogress mother

pages.description: [establishing shot of king dying, prince becomes king]

pages.caption: city,
pages.description: [wide view of king dying, prince becomes king]

pages.caption: she riding between her two children.

pages.description: [close-up detail of new king departing for war]

pages.caption: her care his wife and children.

pages.caption: might with the more ease gratify her horrible longing.
pages.description: [characters in ogress sending queen to country house]
pages.scene: Ogress sending queen to country house

pages.caption: kitchen:
pages.description: [close-up detail of ogress speaking to the clerk of the kitchen]

pages.caption: the clerk of the kitchen.

pages.caption: the bottom of the courtyard.

pages.caption: his hand,
pages.description: [characters in clerk finding little day fencing with monkey]

pages.caption: years of age.

pages.description: [close-up detail of clerk carrying day away, hiding with sister]

pages.caption: wonderfully good.

pages.caption: deceive her.

pages.scene: Clerk despairing, entering queen's chamber with dagger

pages.scene: Clerk despairing, entering queen's chamber with dagger

pages.caption: asleep;
pages.description: [wide view of clerk despairing, entering queen's chamber with dagger]
pages.scene: Clerk despairing, entering queen's chamber with dagger

pages.scene: Clerk despairing, entering queen's chamber with dagger

pages.scene: Clerk despairing, entering queen's chamber with dagger

pages.description: [atmospheric shot of clerk despairing, entering queen's chamber with dagger]
pages.scene: Clerk despairing, entering queen's chamber with dagger

pages.caption: room with his dagger in his hand.

pages.description: [wide view of clerk weeping, refusing to kill]

pages.caption: by giving her in your stead a young hind."

pages.description: [wide view of queen embracing children]

pages.caption: been the young Queen.

pages.caption: the King,

pages.description: [characters in ogress delighted with her cruelty]

pages.caption: her two children.
